:::{#def-model-family}
#### Mean-function model family

A **mean-function model family** $\modelfam$ is a set of functions,
each of which maps a [covariate](#def-covariate) value $\predvar$
to a candidate for the value $\truemeanfnf{\predvar}$ of the [mean function](#def-mean-function) at $\predvar$.

:::
